message.vuties.hover_unavailable: §cHover Mode unavailable! Requires Rotorpack Mk II.
tooltip.vuties.rotorpack.desc.mk1: Reinforced leather harness. Reliable VTOL vertical lift and descent, without hover or glider wings.
tooltip.vuties.rotorpack.desc.mk2: Iron chassis with dual gyroscopic stabilizers. Unlocks stationary aerial hover mode.
tooltip.vuties.rotorpack.desc.mk3: Diamond aerospace frame with deployable wings: VTOL lift, hover, and supersonic glider cruise.
tooltip.vuties.rotorpack.controls.mk3: [Space] Ascend | [Shift] Descend | [Ctrl] Glider Wings | [V] Engine | [H] Hover
